source_note: Expert episode 29 (layout 15 / style 28, 'Pick the fish from the sink and place it on the plate located on the counter.'). The expert grasped the fish across its middle at fingertip height ~77 and lifted it to ~111-117 cm (20-25 cm above the counter) before carrying it to the plate. The command plan below follows that and was verified with the executor.
note: The object (a fish, about 20 cm long) lies in the sink basin, below the counter top; the plate is on the counter to the right of the sink. Long objects: grasp across the MIDDLE of the body with the fingers pointing down (the fingers close left-right, across the fish), at the body's own height (descend until the fingertips touch it). The order matters: FIRST lift straight up (a little back, away from the faucet) until the object's LOWEST point is well above the counter top and the sink rim (here the fingertips went to ~114 cm, 22 cm above the counter), THEN carry it sideways at that height in 10 cm steps until it is above the plate centre, THEN lower it onto the plate, release, and lift the gripper away (more than 25 cm from the object). Moving sideways while the object is still low drags it against the sink wall and pulls it out of the fingers.

turns.scene: Fish lying in the sink basin, about 30 cm right of the fingertips and 28 cm further forward; plate on the counter far to the right.
turns.plan: Point the fingers down and move right until the fingertips are above the fish's line.

turns.scene: Fingertips above the sink, right of centre, behind the fish.
turns.plan: Move forward until the fingertips are above the middle of the fish.

turns.scene: Fingertips about 52 cm above the fish's middle.
turns.plan: Descend into the sink towards the fish.

turns.scene: Fingertips just above the fish's middle, fingers open across its body.
turns.plan: Descend until the fingertips touch the fish (the move stops on contact).

turns.scene: Fingers around the middle of the fish.
Fish held across its middle (opening 0.64: something is between the fingers).
turns.plan: Lift STRAIGHT UP first, a little back away from the faucet, until the whole fish is well above the counter top.

turns.scene: Fish held high above the sink, its lowest point well above the counter top.
turns.plan: Only now carry it sideways towards the plate, at this height, in 10 cm steps.

turns.scene: Fish above the counter, between the sink and the plate.
turns.plan: Finish the sideways carry until the fish is above the plate centre.

turns.scene: Fish held above the middle of the plate.
turns.plan: Lower it until it rests on the plate (the move stops on contact).

turns.scene: Fish lying on the plate, still held.

turns.plan: Move the gripper well away: straight up (the check needs more than 25 cm between gripper and object).
